professor_requirement_addressed: complete the cluster-aware type-I/power grid needed to determine provenance-cluster minima/caps and Y1/Y0 validation quotas
candidate_inference: restricted-null beta-binomial nuisance plug-in Monte Carlo test preserving the exact observed cluster-size vector

candidate_cluster_design.relative_NI_cluster_counts: exactly equal independent provenance-cluster counts in the two compared cells

power_planning.target_origin: continuity with the project's prior prespecified approximately-80%-power planning; the professor required recomputation under the corrected cluster-aware design but did not replace the planning target

stress_relative_NI_alternative.role: sensitivity only; not used alone to select the primary design

primary_FPR_alternative.rationale: the frozen A-opt threshold-selection rule retains thresholds with empirical FPR <= 0.025

broad_grid_decision_rule.typeI_pruning: a G value is clearly inadmissible if any type-I task has MC95% lower endpoint above its nominal alpha
broad_grid_decision_rule.primary_power_screen: among type-I-admissible G values, identify the smallest G with point-estimate power >=0.80 for both primary relative-NI alternatives, the primary absolute-FNR alternative, and the primary FPR alternative
broad_grid_decision_rule.final_freeze: do not freeze from this 500x199 screen; run high-repetition confirmation at the selected G and neighboring G values with beta-binomial, two-point, and logit-normal generators

historical_power_code_status: the old KC/CR2 power screen is historical only and cannot determine the final quotas because that inferential procedure was rejected

broad_grid_result.important: G=140 is only a broad-screen candidate. Final freeze requires high-repetition confirmation with beta-binomial, two-point, and logit-normal generators and unequal within-envelope cluster-size distributions.
